info.title: SIDE ROOM API
info.description: Discord-shaped REST API. `/api/v10` is an alias of `/api/v1`.

get.summary: Page through the staff access log, newest first (`VIEW_ACCESS_LOG`).
Verify the whole hash chain (`VIEW_ACCESS_LOG`). A break raises a staff alert.
Search accounts (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`), paginated by id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Username, display name, email fragment or exact id

get.summary: Account drawer (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`). The read is logged.

post.summary: Platform-ban the Person behind an account (`PLATFORM_BAN`).

get.summary: Credit balance and ledger (newest first).

post.summary: Grant or revoke invite credits with a reason.
Record an account deletion request (stub: nothing is deleted) (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).
Revoke every session of an account (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).

get.summary: Accounts invited, directly or not, up to `depth` hops (at most 500 nodes).
Inviter chain (root first) and stats of an account. The read is logged.

post.summary: Remove TOTP, recovery codes and passkeys and end all sessions (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).
Suspend (deactivate) an account; its sessions end (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).
Reactivate a suspended account if the account cap allows (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`).

get.summary: List platform bans, newest first (`PLATFORM_BAN`).

List the registered feature modules with their platform state (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).
The registry may be sparse: only registered features appear.

patch.summary: Enable, disable or configure a feature at the platform scope (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).

get.summary: List platform invites, newest first.

delete.summary: Revoke an open invite.

get.summary: List jobs, newest first (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

delete.summary: Delete a dead job (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

post.summary: Re-queue a dead job (`MANAGE_TRANSCODE`).

put.summary: Change a chapter's number, title, volume or release group (`PUBLISH_READING`).

delete.summary: Delete a chapter and its pages (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: Preview a chapter's page manifest, published or not (`PUBLISH_READING`).

put.summary:
Replace the whole page list of an image chapter: this is how pages are reordered,
replaced and removed (`PUBLISH_READING`). Object keys must live under
`library/{series_id}/{chapter_id}/`.

post.summary: Publish a chapter; it needs pages (`PUBLISH_READING`).
Unpublish a chapter (`PUBLISH_READING` or `DELETE_CONTENT`).

put.summary: Change an edition (`PUBLISH_READING`).

delete.summary: Delete an edition and its chapters (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

post.summary: Add a draft chapter to an edition (`PUBLISH_READING`).
Add a volume to an edition (`PUBLISH_READING`).

get.summary: All series, drafts included (`PUBLISH_READING`).

parameters.name: genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated genres the series must have.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tags the series must have.

parameters.name: published
parameters.description: `true` for published, `false` for drafts and unpublished series.

post.summary: Create a draft series (`PUBLISH_READING`).

get.summary: A series with its editions, published or not (`PUBLISH_READING`).

put.summary: Replace the editable fields of a series (`PUBLISH_READING`).

delete.summary: Delete a series with everything under it (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: Editions, volumes and every chapter of a series, published or not (`PUBLISH_READING`).

post.summary: Add an edition (`PUBLISH_READING`).

Merge this series into another (`PUBLISH_READING` and `DELETE_CONTENT`): editions,
chapters, follows and progress move; this series stays as a redirect.
Publish a series (`PUBLISH_READING`).
Unpublish a series (`PUBLISH_READING` or `DELETE_CONTENT`).

delete.summary: Delete a volume; its chapters stay, ungrouped (`DELETE_CONTENT`).

get.summary: `GET /admin/me`: the caller's platform permissions (any staff member).
A Person and its accounts (`MANAGE_ACCOUNTS`). The read is logged.

post.summary: Platform-ban a Person (`PLATFORM_BAN`).
Clear a Person's suspicion level (reason required).
Lift a Person's ban; accounts return while the cap allows (`PLATFORM_BAN`).

get.summary: Every editable platform setting with its current value (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).

patch.summary: Change platform settings and limits without a restart (`MANAGE_FEATURES`).

get.summary: List staff (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

post.summary: Appoint an account: adds it to the Staff Server with the roles (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

get.summary: Staff Server roles that can be assigned (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

delete.summary: Revoke an appointment (`APPOINT_STAFF`). The Owner cannot be revoked.

put.summary: Replace a staff member's roles (`APPOINT_STAFF`).

get.summary: Dashboard counts (`STAFF_BASIC`).
Persons with suspicion above zero, highest first.
System status: version, readiness probes, gateway sessions, queue depth (`OPERATOR`).
Get a guild channel the caller can view.

delete.summary: Delete a guild channel; a deleted category orphans its children.

patch.summary: Modify a guild channel. Needs `MANAGE_CHANNELS`.

post.summary: Request an upload slot for each file.

413.description: File larger than the caller's limit

post.summary: Mark an uploaded file complete and learn its verified content type.

parameters.name: upload_id
parameters.description: Upload id from the slot response

get.summary: Active invites of a channel (`MANAGE_CHANNELS`).

post.summary:
Create an invite (`CREATE_INSTANT_INVITE`). With `external: true` the defaults
are single use; explicit `max_age`/`max_uses` always win.

get.summary: Get channel messages.

post.summary: Create a message.
post.description:
Mentions are parsed with `sr-markdown` and gated by permissions (`@everyone`,
unmentionable roles ping nobody). A repeated `nonce` from the same author in the
same channel within five minutes returns the original message instead of
creating another.

post.summary: Bulk delete 2-100 messages younger than 14 days (MANAGE_MESSAGES).

get.summary: Pins with pin times (Discord's newer shape). At most 250 pins exist, so one page.
Search one channel (or DM) the caller can read.

parameters.name: has
parameters.description: link, embed, file, image, video, sound, sticker, poll

get.summary: Get a single channel message.

delete.summary: Delete a message (author, or MANAGE_MESSAGES). Soft delete: purged after 30 days.

patch.summary: Edit a message (author only for content; embed suppression also by MANAGE_MESSAGES).

post.summary:
Acknowledge a message: the marker moves forward to it and the mention badge
resets. With `manual: true` ("mark as unread") the marker is set to exactly this
message and `mention_count` is restored.

delete.summary: Remove every reaction from a message (MANAGE_MESSAGES).

get.summary: List the users who reacted with an emoji.

delete.summary: Remove all reactions of one emoji (MANAGE_MESSAGES).

put.summary: Add the caller's reaction.

parameters.name: emoji
parameters.description: Unicode emoji, or `name:id` for custom emoji (URL-encoded)

delete.summary: Remove the caller's reaction.
Remove another user's reaction (MANAGE_MESSAGES).

post.summary:
Start a thread from a message. The thread's id is the message's id; a message can
have one thread. Needs `CREATE_PUBLIC_THREADS`.

put.summary: Create or replace a permission overwrite (`type` 0 role, 1 member).

delete.summary: Delete a permission overwrite.

get.summary: Legacy pins list (array of messages).

post.summary: Mark the channel's pins as seen.

put.summary: Pin a message (MANAGE_MESSAGES, max 250 per channel).

delete.summary: Unpin a message.

get.summary: Users who voted for an answer, ascending by id.

put.summary: Vote for an answer. A single-choice poll moves the caller's earlier vote.

400.description: Unknown answer or the poll has ended

delete.summary: Withdraw the caller's vote for an answer.

post.summary: End a poll now. Only the author can; the final results go out as `MESSAGE_UPDATE`.

put.summary:
Add a friend to a group DM. Adding to a 1:1 DM spawns a new group and returns
it (200); adding to a group answers 204.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a group DM (owner), or leave it (yourself).

get.summary: Members of a thread, ordered by user id (`after` pages; `limit` 1-100).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Last user id of the previous page

get.summary: One thread member.

put.summary: Add a member to a thread (`@me` joins). The thread must not be archived.

delete.summary:
Remove a member from a thread (`@me` leaves). Removing others needs
`MANAGE_THREADS`, or being the owner of a private thread.

post.summary:
Start a thread without a message, or a post in a forum or media channel (then
`message` is required and becomes the first message).

get.summary: Every archived private thread of a channel. Needs `MANAGE_THREADS`.

Archived public threads (and forum posts) of a channel, newest archive first.
`before` is the ISO8601 `archive_timestamp` of the last thread of the previous page.

post.summary: Trigger the typing indicator.

get.summary: Archived private threads of a channel that the caller joined.
Webhooks of a channel (`MANAGE_WEBHOOKS`).

post.summary:
Create a webhook in a channel (`MANAGE_WEBHOOKS`; 15 per channel). The response
carries the token once.
Create a guild with `@everyone`, two categories, `#general` and a voice channel.

201.description: The new guild with its roles and channels

get.summary: Preview a template by its code (any signed-in user).
Get a guild (members only).

delete.summary: Delete a guild (owner only; the Staff Server cannot be deleted).

patch.summary: Modify a guild; `MANAGE_GUILD`, or the owner for `owner_id`.

post.summary:
Mark a whole guild as read: every channel the caller can view that has a message
is acknowledged up to its latest message (and its mention badge resets).

get.summary:
List audit-log entries, newest first (`VIEW_AUDIT_LOG`). Filter by `user_id`
and `action_type`; page with `before`.
List the guild's AutoMod rules (`MANAGE_GUILD`).

post.summary:
Create a rule (`MANAGE_GUILD`). Per-type quotas follow Discord: 6 keyword rules,
3 link rules, 1 of every other type.

get.summary: Get one rule (`MANAGE_GUILD`).

delete.summary: Delete a rule (`MANAGE_GUILD`).

patch.summary: Modify a rule (`MANAGE_GUILD`).

get.summary: List bans (`BAN_MEMBERS`), ordered by user id.
Get one ban (`BAN_MEMBERS`).

put.summary: Ban a user (member or not). The reason comes from `X-Audit-Log-Reason` or the body.

delete.summary: Remove a ban (`BAN_MEMBERS`).

get.summary: Channels of the guild that the caller can view.

post.summary: Create a channel or category (`type` 4). Needs `MANAGE_CHANNELS`.

patch.summary: Bulk update `position` and `parent_id`. Needs `MANAGE_CHANNELS`.

get.summary: List a guild's emoji (any member).

post.summary:
Upload an emoji (`CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS` or `MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS`).
250 static and 250 animated slots for every server (open question 135).

400.description: Invalid image, or 30008 when the slots are full

get.summary: Get one emoji (any member).

delete.summary: Delete an emoji (`MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS`).

patch.summary: Rename an emoji or change its role restriction (`MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS`).

get.summary:
Mint a short-lived signed CDN URL for an emoji image (any member). Emoji
objects carry no URL, so clients ask here and may request `size`/`format`.
Active invites of a guild (`MANAGE_GUILD`), newest first.
Page through the members of a guild, ordered by user id.
Get one member.

delete.summary: Remove a member from the guild (`KICK_MEMBERS`, hierarchy applies).

patch.summary: Modify nickname, roles or timeout of a member, subject to the role hierarchy.

put.summary: Add a role to a member.

delete.summary: Remove a role from a member.

get.summary: Search a guild's messages across every channel the caller can read.

parameters.name: has
parameters.description: link, embed, file, image, video, sound, sticker, poll

get.summary: Onboarding settings (any member; the answer options are what new members see).

put.summary:
Replace the onboarding configuration (`MANAGE_GUILD`). Enabling it needs 7
default channels, 5 of them open to `@everyone`; at most 15 questions with 50
answers each. Ids you omit are assigned.

get.summary: Roles of the guild (members only), ordered by position.

post.summary: Create a role directly above `@everyone`. Needs `MANAGE_ROLES`; the caller can only grant bits they hold.

patch.summary: Bulk update role positions. Returns every role of the guild.

delete.summary: Delete a role the caller outranks; members lose it.

patch.summary: Modify a role the caller outranks.

get.summary: SIDE ROOM community and safety settings (`MANAGE_GUILD`).

patch.summary:
Edit community and safety settings (`MANAGE_GUILD`). Enabling community
needs a rules and an updates channel plus the verification and content-filter
levels from the safety checklist.

get.summary: List a guild's stickers (any member).

post.summary: Upload a sticker (`MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS`); 60 slots for every server.

400.description: Invalid file, or 30039 when the slots are full

get.summary: Get one sticker (any member).

delete.summary: Delete a sticker (`MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS`).

patch.summary: Edit a sticker's name, description or tags (`MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS`).

get.summary: Mint a short-lived signed CDN URL for a sticker image (any member).
The guild's template, if it has one (`MANAGE_GUILD`).

post.summary: Create the guild's template (`MANAGE_GUILD`); a guild has at most one.

put.summary: Sync the template with the guild's current state (`MANAGE_GUILD`).

delete.summary: Delete the template (`MANAGE_GUILD`); returns it.

patch.summary: Change the template's name or description (`MANAGE_GUILD`).

get.summary: Unarchived threads of a guild that the caller can see, with their memberships.
Webhooks of a guild (`MANAGE_WEBHOOKS`).
The welcome screen. Members see it while it is enabled; managers always.

patch.summary: Edit the welcome screen (`MANAGE_GUILD`): up to 5 channel cards.

get.summary:
Resolve an invite code (any signed-in user). Revoked, expired and used-up
invites are all `Unknown Invite`. With `with_counts=true` the guild's
`approximate_member_count` and `approximate_presence_count` are included;
`expires_at` is always present (null for invites that never expire).

parameters.name: with_counts
parameters.description: Include approximate member and presence counts

post.summary:
Accept an invite and join the guild. The member is added and exactly one use
consumed atomically. Already being a member returns the invite without using
it up. Banned users get 403 `User banned`; paused invites 403. Bots cannot
join by invite.

delete.summary:
Revoke an invite (`MANAGE_CHANNELS` on its channel or `MANAGE_GUILD`). Returns
the revoked invite.

get.summary: The reader's page manifest: sized, signed image URLs plus neighbouring chapters.
The caller's followed series ("My library"), newest follow first.
Instant search: matching series plus author, genre and tag suggestions.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search-box text; every word is matched as a prefix.

get.summary: Browse the catalog with filters, sort and pagination.

parameters.name: genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated; a series must have every one.

parameters.name: exclude_genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated; a series with any of them is left out.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated; a series must have every one.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: BCP 47 tag: series with a published chapter in this language.

parameters.name: age
parameters.description: `hide` (default), `include` or `only`. Only accounts that confirmed they are 18+ get restricted series.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `asc` or `desc`; default depends on the sort.

get.summary: A series with its editions and the caller's follow. A merged series answers with its target.
Chapters of a series with volumes, editions and the caller's read marks.

put.summary: Follow a series, or change its shelf and notification setting.

delete.summary: Stop following a series.

get.summary: Latest published chapters, newest first.

post.summary: Acknowledge many channels at once ("mark server as read").

get.summary: The CSRF token for the current session.
The authenticated caller (as a Discord-shaped user object).

patch.summary:
Edit the caller's profile: `avatar` and `banner` (image data URIs, stored by the
media pipeline), `bio` (190), `pronouns` (40), `accent_color` and
`custom_status`. Absent fields stay, `null` clears (and deletes the stored
image). Publishes `USER_UPDATE`.

get.summary: Open conversations of the caller (hidden ones excluded), newest first.

post.summary:
Open (or find) a 1:1 DM with `recipient_id`, or create a group DM from
`recipients` (the caller's friends).

delete.summary: Close a 1:1 DM (it reappears on the next message) or leave a group DM.

patch.summary: Rename a group DM, change its icon, or transfer ownership (owner only).

put.summary: Move a Message Request to `accepted`, `ignored` or `spam`.

get.summary: Guilds the caller belongs to. Bearer tokens need the `guilds` scope.

delete.summary: Leave a guild. The owner must transfer ownership first.

get.summary: Settings of one guild (`@me` for DMs) with the caller's channel overrides in it.

patch.summary:
Change notification level, mutes and suppression toggles of a guild, plus
overrides for channels in it. A mute is `muted: true` with an optional
`mute_config.selected_time_window` (seconds, or -1 until turned off).

get.summary: Users the caller has ignored (Q110: independent of friendship).

put.summary:
Ignore a user: their messages, activity and DM notifications are hidden, the
friendship stays.

delete.summary: Stop ignoring a user.

get.summary: The caller's note on a user; 404 when there is none.

put.summary: Set the note (max 256 characters); an empty or null note deletes it.

get.summary: The stored presence preference with expiries applied.

patch.summary:
Choose `online`, `idle`, `dnd` or `invisible` (optionally for
`duration_seconds`) and set or clear the custom status.

get.summary: The caller's own profile.
Every read marker of the caller (the gateway READY payload carries the same list).
All relationships of the caller: friends, blocks and pending requests.

post.summary:
Send a friend request by username (case-insensitive). An unknown user, a user
who blocked the caller and a user who takes no requests all answer the same
"unable to add" error, so usernames cannot be enumerated.

get.summary: One relationship of the caller; 404 when there is none.

put.summary:
Send a friend request, accept an incoming one (`type` 1 or omitted), or block
(`type` 2).

delete.summary: Remove a friend, cancel or decline a request, or unblock.

patch.summary: Set or clear a friend's private nickname (max 32 characters).

get.summary:
A user's profile: bio, pronouns, banner, accent colour and the connections they
made visible.
Get a webhook (`MANAGE_WEBHOOKS`).

delete.summary: Delete a webhook (`MANAGE_WEBHOOKS`).

patch.summary: Modify a webhook's name or channel (`MANAGE_WEBHOOKS`).

get.summary: Get a webhook by id and token (no other authentication).

post.summary:
Execute a webhook: post a message into its channel. `?wait=true` returns the
message. A wrong token and an unknown id both answer 404.

delete.summary: Delete a webhook by id and token.

patch.summary: Modify a webhook's name by id and token.

prev_hash.description: Hex of the previous row's hash (all zeros for the first row).

next_before.description: Pass as `before` to get the next (older) page.

AccountPage.description: A page of accounts; `next_after` is the cursor for the following page.

manual.description: "Mark as unread": move the marker to exactly this message.

mention_count.description: With `manual`, the mention badge to restore.

type.description: 1 block message, 2 send alert message, 3 timeout.

AddRelationshipBody.description: `POST /users/@me/relationships`: send a friend request by username.

username.description:
The target's username, case-insensitive. The platform has no
discriminators; a `discriminator` field is accepted and ignored.

delta.description: Positive grants credits, negative revokes them (-1000..1000, not 0).

AgeFilter.description: How age-restricted series are treated by a listing.

AllowedMentionsBody.description:
Discord's `allowed_mentions` object. `parse` may hold `users`, `roles` and
`everyone`; listed `users`/`roles` ids may ping even when their kind is not parsed.

role_ids.description: Staff Server role ids to start with.

expires_at.description: Set when the attachment is a large file that will expire.

url.description: Relative CDN path (`/cdn/attachments/...`); signing happens at the edge.

AttachmentRef.description: An uploaded file referenced by a new message.

duration_secs.description: Voice messages: length in seconds (at most 120).

id.description: The `id` returned by the upload-slot call (client id echo or upload id).

waveform.description: Voice messages: base64 waveform of up to 256 amplitude bytes.

AuditLogObject.description:
The audit-log envelope. The lists SIDE ROOM does not populate yet are empty
arrays so Discord clients can parse the shape.

BanBody.description: Ban body: the reason is the ban note.

category.description: `serious` raises suspicion on the inviter (D-031); `standard` does not.

BanCategory.description:
Reason category of a platform ban (doc 06 section 5.4, doc 09). Only
`Serious` bans raise suspicion on the banned account's inviter (D-031).

oneOf.description: Set when a serious ban raised suspicion on the inviter's Person.

ChainReport.description: Result of verifying the whole chain.

first_bad_seq.description: First sequence number that failed verification.

head_hash.description: Hash of the newest verified row; record it elsewhere to detect truncation.

applied_tags.description: Forum tag ids applied to a post.

available_tags.description: Forum and media channels: the tags a post can carry.

oneOf.description: The requesting user's membership of a thread.

message_count.description: Messages in a thread, capped at 50.

total_message_sent.description: Every message ever sent in a thread.

muted.description: `false` unmutes; `true` mutes for `mute_config` (default until turned off).

oneOf.description: The caller's progress (read / unread marks); absent when there is none.

source_key.description: Storage key of the original file (`pdf` / `epub` chapters).

invites_paused.description: Security Actions: invites are paused for everyone (LNG-SSET-038).

raid_alert_joins_per_minute.description: Alert when more than this many members join per minute; 0 = off.

flags.description: Forum and media channels: `REQUIRE_TAG` (1 << 4) and similar settings bits.

type.description: Discord channel type; defaults to 0 (text). 4 creates a category.

recipients.description: A group DM with these users (the caller becomes the owner).

image.description: `data:image/png;base64,...` (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP; at most 256 KiB).

roles.description: Role ids that may use the emoji; empty or absent = everyone.

icon.description: Accepted for compatibility; icon upload arrives with the media pipeline.

CreateInviteBody.description: Body of `POST /channels/{id}/invites`. Every field is optional.

external.description:
SIDE ROOM: the invite is for sharing outside the platform ("Copy link").
It defaults to a single use (open question 134).

unique.description: Accepted for Discord compatibility; every call creates a new invite.

components.description: Components are stored as sent; interactions are not supported yet.

embeds.description: Embeds are stored as sent (open question 98); at most 10.

enforce_nonce.description:
When true, a nonce already used in the window returns the original message with 200
instead of creating another (open question 151).

sticker_ids.description: Not supported yet (stickers/polls have no storage); a non-empty value is rejected.

file.description: Data URI: PNG, APNG, GIF or Lottie JSON (at most 512 KiB).

tags.description: A related emoji or comma-separated tags.

CurrentUser.description:
Body of `GET /users/@me`: a Discord-shaped user object. Session callers get
the full object (including their own `email`); bot and bearer callers get the
id, `bot` and the placeholder fields only, since no account row backs them.

avatar.description: Avatar hash; the image is at `/cdn/avatars/{id}/{hash}.png`.

banner.description: Profile banner hash, served like the avatar.

display_name.description: Same as `global_name` (SIDE ROOM name for the field).

email.description: The caller's own email (session callers only).

global_name.description: The display name, if the account set one.

mfa_enabled.description: Whether TOTP is confirmed on the account (session callers).

verified.description: Whether the email address was verified (session callers).

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry; omitted keeps it until cleared.

is_message_request.description: Set only on a conversation sitting in the viewer's Message Requests.

recipients.description: Everyone except the viewer, in join order.

avatar.description:
New avatar as a `data:image/{png,jpeg,gif,webp};base64,...` URI (8 MiB at
most; cropped to a centred square, EXIF stripped); `null` removes it.

banner.description:
New profile banner as an image data URI (aspect ratio kept, at most
1920x1080); `null` removes it.

code.description: Numeric error code (Discord's where one exists, `>= 900000` for SIDE ROOM).

enabled.description: Whether the feature is on at the platform scope (a platform-off is a kill switch).

settings.description: Effective settings at the platform scope.

content_type.description: What the client believes the type is; verified by sniffing at completion.

Follow.description: A followed series with the user's shelf.

ForumSettingsBody.description: Forum and media settings, plus the thread defaults of text channels.

default_auto_archive_duration.description: Minutes of inactivity before new threads auto-archive.

banner.description: Banner hash, same URL shape as the icon.

splash.description: Invite splash hash, same URL shape as the icon.

truncated.description: True when the node cap cut the result short.

InviteNode.description: A node of the invite graph.

depth.description: Hops from the requested account (0 = itself, negative = ancestors).

parent_id.description: The inviter's account id (`None` for the root: the Owner).

approximate_member_count.description: Members of the guild; only with `with_counts=true`.

approximate_presence_count.description:
Members visibly online; only with `with_counts=true`, and only when the
server has a live presence source (the gateway). Omitted otherwise.

InviteTree.description: The inviter chain of an account plus its stats.

ancestors.description: Root first, ending with the account's direct inviter.

platform_permissions.description: `PlatformPermissions` bits as a decimal string (`OWNER` is bit 63).

target_id.description: The series that stays; this one is merged into it.

message_snapshots.description: Forwarded messages: the copy taken at forward time.

thread.description: The thread started from this message (a thread has its starter's id).

channel_id.description: Source channel of a forward (a reply stays in this channel).

fail_if_not_exists.description:
Default true: a missing target is an error. When false the message is
sent without a reply.

type.description: 0 (default) replies, 1 forwards the referenced message into this channel.

flags.description: Forum channels: setting bits; threads: `PINNED` (1 << 1) for forum posts.

lock_permissions.description: Copy the category's overwrites onto this channel.

banner.description: Banner image data URI (aspect ratio kept, at most 1920x1080); `null` removes it.

icon.description:
Image data URI (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, 8 MiB at most; cropped to a square);
`null` removes the icon.

splash.description: Invite splash image data URI; `null` removes it.

communication_disabled_until.description: ISO8601 end of the timeout, or `null` to clear it.

channel_id.description: Move to another channel of the same server (management endpoint only).

MuteConfigIn.description: Mute window of a change that sets `muted: true`.

selected_time_window.description: 900, 3600, 10800, 28800, 86400 seconds, or -1 for "until I turn it back on".

member_since.description: When the profile owner joined that guild.

nick.description: The profile owner's nickname in that guild.

nickname.description: Empty or null clears the nickname (max 32 characters).

note.description: Empty or null clears the note (max 256 characters).

id.description: Omit on create; the server assigns ids.
Required when creating a channel, ignored on `PUT`.

variants.description: Smaller signed variants; pick by viewport width times device pixel ratio.

key.description: Full-size WebP object key; must live under `library/{series}/{chapter}/`.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds when the signed URLs stop working.

enabled.description: Turn the feature on or off at the platform scope.

reset_enabled.description: Drop the explicit platform flag so the feature default applies again.

settings.description: Replace the platform-scope setting overrides (validated against the feature schema).

values.description: Setting key to new value; unknown keys or out-of-range values reject the whole patch.

source_account_id.description: The account the ban is about; a serious ban raises suspicion on its inviter.

duration_seconds.description: Revert to `online` after this many seconds (for example "DND for 1 hour").

friends_since.description: When the viewer and the owner became friends.

mutual_friends.description:
Friends of both the viewer and the profile owner (omitted on the viewer's own
profile).

mutual_guilds.description:
Guilds both belong to, with the owner's nickname and join time there.
Present when `with_mutual_guilds` is true (the default) and the profile is
not the viewer's own.

type.description: 1 (default) sends or accepts a friend request, 2 blocks.

ReadingDirection.description: Default reading mode of a series.

ReasonBody.description: Body of actions that only need a reason.

reason.description:
Why. Required for account, Person, invite and staff actions; also accepted in the
`X-Audit-Log-Reason` header.

type.description: 1 friend, 2 blocked, 3 incoming request, 4 outgoing request.

RuleBody.description:
Body of create (all of `name`, `event_type`, `trigger_type`, `actions` required)
and modify (every field optional; `trigger_type` cannot change).

SearchResponse.description:
Discord search response: each result is a one-message group (no context
lines), flagged with `hit: true`.

Series.description: A series as the API shows it.

SeriesInput.description: Editable fields of a series (create, and full replace on update).

oneOf.description: Defaults from the kind (webtoon: vertical, comic: ltr, manga: rtl).

SettingView.description: One platform setting with its current value, for Admin -> Limits.

Shelf.description: The "My library" shelf of a followed series.

platform_permissions.description: Union of the roles' platform bits (`OWNER` for the Owner), decimal string.

StaffRole.description: A staff role of the Staff Server.

auto_archive_duration.description: Minutes of inactivity before archiving: 60, 1440, 4320 or 10080.

StartThreadBody.description:
`POST /channels/{id}/threads`. In a forum or media channel `message` is required
and becomes the post's first message.

applied_tags.description: Forum and media channels: tag ids, at most 5.

invitable.description: Private threads: whether members may invite others.

oneOf.description: Forum and media channels: the starter message (no attachments yet).

frozen.description: Level reached the freeze threshold: the Person's invite creation is frozen.

SystemCounts.description: Counts for the dashboard and system page.

gateway_sessions.description: Open gateway sessions, when the gateway is attached.

TagBody.description: A forum tag as sent by clients; the server assigns an id when absent.

is_dirty.description: Whether the guild changed since the last sync (guild-scoped reads only).

serialized_source_guild.description: The snapshot: `settings`, `roles` and `channels` with local ids.

ThreadList.description: Thread listings: the threads plus the caller's memberships among them.

ThreadMemberObject.description: A thread member (`thread-members` endpoints and `member` of a thread object).

ThreadMetadataObject.description: Thread-only fields of a channel object (`thread_metadata`).

ThreadResponse.description: A thread channel object; for forum posts also the starter `message`.

accounts_left_deactivated.description: Accounts left deactivated because the account cap was reached.

UpdateItem.description: One entry of the latest-updates feed.

next_before.description: Pass back as `before` for the next page; absent at the end.

expires_after.description: Large files expire after this many seconds; absent for normal files.

id.description: Echo of the client id (or the upload id when none was sent).

max_size.description: The maximum accepted size for this caller.

upload_filename.description: Opaque name to pass as `uploaded_filename` when creating the message.

upload_id.description: Server-side upload id; reference it from the message.

message_notifications.description: 0 all messages, 1 only mentions, 2 nothing; `null` inherits the guild default.

avatar.description: Avatar hash (`/cdn/avatars/{id}/{hash}.png`), when one is set.

banner.description: Profile banner hash (`/cdn/avatars/{id}/{hash}.png`), when one is set.

UserRef.description:
User object embedded in messages (author, mentions). Fields come from the user
lookup (open question 157); without a row only the id is known.

token.description: Only in the creation response; it cannot be recovered afterwards.

url.description: Execution path, only when the token is known.

session.name: sr_session
session.description: Browser session; non-GET requests also need `X-SR-CSRF`
